answer: Propose one shared auction for reef surveys, nebula maps and violet identification, preventing category hopping: 40 permits/day, reserve 3 credits each. Validators check burned payments and exclusive key/day bindings; absent or reused permits bar admission. Fees recur; servers are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Shared hosts and parallel agents cannot share permits. Credits must have value; wealth can buy every slot. Eight active keys burn at least 8 x 3 = 24 credits/day; the cap is 40 keys, not 40 distinct owners.
